name: 多尔特·梅茨
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:2855
who: Dort Metz, a human apprentice stonemason from the lower town of the gold-kite city, nineteen in the year 947: tall, about 172 cm, with broad, strong shoulders and back. Both forearms carry a permanent dusting of pale stone powder. Short apricot-red hair is wrapped in a plain grey headscarf, with a few locks sticking out at the forehead. Clear grey-green eyes. A flying stone chip left a small nick at the tail of her left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when she faces us). Wide palms with thick calluses at the heel, nails cut very short. Fair skin. She wears no jewellery, no earrings and no glasses. Steady, plain-spoken and dependable: people say that when she stands beside a stone, the stone is too embarrassed to fall.
build: 172 cm, tall and strong: broad shoulders and a powerful back, a C-cup, a firm waist and full, sturdy hips.
palette: apricot red, stone grey, grey-green, worn leather brown, undyed linen
casual: Her workshop clothes: a coarse undyed linen work smock with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and a double layer of leather sewn over the elbows, a heavy leather apron covered in chisel marks, grey canvas trousers with leather-patched knees, and scuffed work boots. The grey headscarf covers her hair. A flat chisel and a wooden mallet hang from her belt. On her back is a wooden carrying frame with a blank, uncarved slab of stone lashed to it. She stands square, both thumbs hooked in the frame's shoulder straps, with a level, calm look.
private: Off work in the lower town: a loose undyed linen shirt, a brown wool skirt to the ankle, a short wool waistcoat and plain leather shoes. The headscarf is pulled down around her neck so the short apricot-red hair shows. She holds a small plain wooden box in both hands; its lid is carved all over with chisel marks and bears no letters. A thoughtful, closed-mouth look.
battle: Holding a line, in salvaged wall gear over her workshop clothes: the linen smock under a short grey canvas work coat with leather patches on the knees and elbows; a single grey wall-issue enchanted pauldron re-strapped on her right shoulder, its rune line glowing faint blue-white; old enchanted steel bracers on both forearms with one small lit crystal at the left wrist; the headscarf knotted tight. The carrying frame is off. Her left hand grips the blank stone slab upright by its edge as a shield, and her right hand raises a heavy wooden mallet bound with a band of old rune-lit iron. Feet planted wide, a hard, steady stare, the mouth set.
formal: Her one good set for the civic hall: a clean deep-blue wool coat that closes down the front with buttons up to the collar, a white linen shirt, a dark grey wool skirt to the ankle, polished brown boots and a fresh grey headscarf, neatly tied. She stands straight with her large calloused hands folded in front and a plain, serious face.
art: A close portrait tilted on a diagonal, her face large and to one side. Her grey-green eyes look straight at the viewer with a small, calm closed-mouth smile, and one wide calloused hand rests flat on the edge of the blank stone slab on her back. Cold blue-grey dawn light falls from one side and warm lamp orange from the other. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust and chips and the head of a wooden mallet.
battle_old: Holding a line: the linen smock under a short grey canvas work coat with leather patches on the knees and elbows, leather bracers, and the headscarf knotted tight. The carrying frame is off. Her left hand grips the blank stone slab upright by its edge as a shield, and her right hand raises a heavy wooden mallet. Feet planted wide, a hard, steady stare, the mouth set.
gear: 共鸣（LVL 33）｜贫｜照常｜1档｜共鸣的下街碑匠学徒，盾就是那块碑坯。所以在工褂外头罩一两件捡来的墙上附魔件，东边式样，不用火药。

name: 霍格尔·霜檐
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:2912
who: Hogel Frosteave, a human spearman of the far north, twenty in the year 947 and the youngest member of a cheap lower-town mercenary company: tall, about 185 cm, lean, with long arms and legs and shoulders that have not yet filled out. Deep teal hair with a short braid at the back of the head. Ice-blue eyes. An old icicle scar cuts through his left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when he faces us). The tip of his nose and his ears are always red with cold, and a small puff of white frosty breath always hangs at his lips, even in summer. It is only visible breath, NOT a cigarette and NOT smoke. Fair skin. No earrings, no glasses. Restless, chatty and warm-hearted; he loves noise and hates silence.
build: 185 cm, tall and lean with long legs, a wiry runner's frame, the shoulders still filling out.
palette: deep teal, ice blue, frost white, grey sealskin, worn copper
casual: His everyday clothes: a short northern jacket of turned fur, worn fur side in with the hide outside bleached pale, closing down the front with buttons. A small copper badge of three stacked coins is sewn on the left chest (on the viewer's right when he faces us). Under the jacket a coarse wool tunic, wool trousers held by a wide leather belt, and thin southern leather boots that he finds too warm. In his right hand he holds a short ice-breaking spear; its shaft is wrapped in grey sealskin and its iron head always carries a thin crust of frost. A loose, cheeky grin, as if about to make a bet.
private: Off duty at the company house: the fur jacket is off. He wears an undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, wool trousers with braces hanging at the hips, thick knitted socks and the thin boots. He holds a small leather pouch of coarse sea salt out in one hand and rubs the back of his neck with the other, with a sheepish grin.
battle: Ready to fight, in the few salvaged pieces a cheap company can afford: the fur jacket buttoned up to the throat under an old padded company vest with the copper three-coin badge; a single salvaged enchanted pauldron strapped on the right shoulder, its rune line glowing blue-white and its edges rimed by his own cold; one rune-etched steel vambrace on the left forearm with a small lit crystal at the wrist; the braid tucked in. He holds the short ice spear low in both hands with its frosted head forward, a faint ring of frost spreading from the point and runes of ice glowing along the shaft. A light, wide stance, white breath streaming from his lips, a sharp, alert look.
formal: His one good outfit: a clean deep-blue wool coat that closes down the front with buttons, with the fur collar of his northern jacket showing above it, a white linen shirt, and dark trousers tucked into polished boots. The braid is freshly tied with a leather thong. He stands a little too stiffly with his hands behind his back, trying to hold down a grin.
art: A tilted close portrait, his face large and off-centre. His ice-blue eyes look at the viewer with a challenging grin as he breathes a puff of white frost into his cupped palm, NOT smoke. Cold blue light falls from one side and warm firelight orange from behind. Foreground blur: drifting frost crystals, the frosted head of his spear and a few copper pennies.
battle_old: Ready to fight: the fur jacket buttoned up to the throat under a padded leather vest, leather bracers, the braid tucked in. He holds the short ice spear low in both hands with its frosted head forward, a faint ring of frost spreading from the point. A light, wide stance, white breath streaming from his lips, a sharp, alert look.
gear: 共鸣（LVL 36）｜贫｜照常｜1档｜共鸣，又在接便宜活的三便士团，样张给的半身甲加肩甲加护臂加罩袍超了一档。改成翻毛外套外头只罩一件肩甲、一只护臂。

name: 鲁赫莎娜·纺誓
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4339
who: Ruhsana Spinoath, head of the oath-spinner house, a demon of the long-lived crimson-feast lineage. In the year 862 she is about eight hundred and forty years old and looks just past thirty: tall, about 176 cm, thin, with a very straight back. Her dark red hair is woven into nine braids that hang to the waist, and the tip of every braid is wound tight with grey thread. Pomegranate-red eyes that look at a person's palms before their face. Very pale, cold skin; she is always cold and keeps a shawl around her shoulders even in summer. In her right hand she always turns an ebony spindle. A small oath knife hangs at her waist. Slow, cool and exact, she counts in knots and centuries. No jewellery, no glasses.
build: 176 cm, tall and thin, long-limbed, with very upright posture and slender shoulders.
palette: dark red, pomegranate red, ash-grey thread, ebony black, deep wine
casual: Her house dress: a long deep wine-red wool dress that closes down the front with small dark buttons, with fitted long sleeves and a high collar. A heavy ash-grey wool shawl is wrapped over her shoulders. A narrow black belt holds a small straight-bladed oath knife in a plain sheath, and a coil of thin dark red cord tied with many small tight knots hangs from the belt on her left side (on the viewer's right when she faces us). Soft black leather boots. The ebony spindle turns in her right hand while the left holds the shawl closed. She stands very straight, her face patient and unreadable.
private: At home in the southern quarter in later years: a plain dark grey wool dress to the ankle with long sleeves, the ash-grey shawl, soft house shoes, and the nine braids gathered over one shoulder. She holds the ebony spindle with no thread on it and looks at it quietly.
battle: Tying the great knot, in the oath-spinner's battle dress rather than armour: a tailored dark wine-red riding coat buttoned to the throat over the dress, its lining and high collar stitched with fine oath-script in dark red thread that glows like banked coals; the ash-grey shawl thrown back; close black gloves with small red rune knots sewn at the wrists. Nine dark red cords braided into one heavy rope are wrapped around her left forearm, their knots pulsing with faint red light, and her left hand grips a large many-layered knot. Her right hand holds the oath knife drawn, point down. The ebony spindle is tucked through her belt. A cold, intent stare, lips pressed thin.
formal: At the old oath rites: a floor-length deep red robe that closes down the front with buttons, with fitted sleeves and a hem embroidered with a band of small dark knots. A short black cloak is buttoned to the throat with the grey shawl over it. She holds a small dark bronze blood-cup in both hands, and the spindle is tucked in her sash. She stands perfectly still, chin level.
art: A tilted close portrait, her face large and to one side. Her pomegranate eyes are lowered toward the viewer's open hand, with a faint, cold, not-quite smile. Cold pale-violet light falls from one side and a thin warm red rim from the other. Foreground blur: tight dark red knots on a taut cord, the turning ebony spindle and a drifting grey thread.
battle_old: Tying the great knot: a dark wine-red riding coat buttoned to the throat over the dress, the shawl thrown back, black gloves. Nine dark red cords braided into one heavy rope are wrapped around her left forearm, and her left hand grips a large many-layered knot. Her right hand holds the oath knife drawn, point down. The ebony spindle is tucked through her belt. A cold, intent stare, lips pressed thin.
gear: 英雄（估）｜世家｜法袍｜4档｜纺誓家的家主，系了八百年誓结，靠的是结和绳，不靠甲。所以照英雄的料子给她一件量身做的、缝了誓文的骑装，不加护甲。

name: 赞达克
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4358
who: Zandak, a flame-horn demon, seventy-two in the year 862 and still young in body: tall, about 183 cm, lean and hard, with a rider's build. Both horns are sawn off flat at the root, and each stump is bound with an iron band. His whole face is hidden behind a smooth iron mask with no eye holes and no mouth hole, which he put on himself at fifteen; only the edge of a scarred young jaw shows beneath it. Cropped dusty slate-blue hair. His right arm is wound from wrist to shoulder with a dark red blood-cord (on the viewer's left when he faces us). He never speaks and points at things with the end of the cord. No jewellery.
face: FACE, as in the references: a smooth, blank iron mask with no eye holes, no mouth hole and no features covers the whole face from the hairline to below the chin, held by an iron band around the head; no eyes and no mouth are visible at all; beneath its lower edge only a sliver of young jaw crossed by small pale oath scars shows.
build: 183 cm, lean and hard, a horseman's build with long arms and narrow hips.
palette: iron grey, dark blood red, black leather, dusty slate blue
casual: His riding clothes: a black leather short coat with the cuffs clamped tight by iron rings and the right sleeve cut away at the shoulder to bare the arm wound with the dark red cord. Dark wool trousers, worn riding boots and a dark red sash. He stands motionless and faceless, the free end of the cord held loosely in his right hand and pointed at something off to the side.
private: In camp: a plain dark grey wool tunic and trousers, a coarse wool blanket-cloak over the shoulders and plain boots. The mask is still on and the right arm is still wound with the cord. He holds a tin cup of water that he cannot drink from behind the mask.
battle: Hunting with his riders, in a blood-oath rider's war harness: over the black coat a fitted cuirass of dark iron plates and black leather, the seams glowing a dull ember red, heavy iron pauldrons riveted in old brass; iron-ringed vambraces; the smooth iron mask on, its rim faintly warm with red light, iron bands on the horn stumps. The dark red blood-cord is unwound from his right arm and twisted hard into a long rigid spear in his right hand, its tip sharp as iron and lit with red light. A loose net of red cord trails from his left hand. A low, forward-leaning stance.
formal: As a sworn man of the old oath: a long black coat that closes down the front with buttons to the throat, a dark red sash, a short black cloak and polished boots. The iron mask and banded horns are as always, and the blood-cord is wound neatly up to the shoulder. He stands at attention, hands at his sides.
art: A tilted close portrait. The blank iron mask is large and off-centre, angled toward the viewer as if listening. Deep red light glints across the mask from one side and cold iron blue from the other, and the iron-banded horn stumps catch the light. Foreground blur: a loop of dark red cord and drifting road dust.
battle_old: Hunting with his riders: dark leather armour with iron plates at the shoulders over the black coat, the iron mask on, iron bands on the horn stumps. The dark red blood-cord is unwound from his right arm and twisted hard into a long rigid spear in his right hand, its tip sharp as iron. A loose net of red cord trails from his left hand. A low, forward-leaning stance.
gear: 极境（估）｜中（估）｜照常｜3档｜血誓那一边最能打的一个，所以估他是极境。给他一身成套的余烬黑铁骑甲，招牌是铁面和那根血绳。

name: 哈索·旱渡
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4376
who: Hasso Drywade, a tiefling and head of the dry-river ferrymen, sixty-two in the year 867: short, about 160 cm, stocky and bow-legged. A pair of worn, rounded grey horns at his temples and very short iron-grey hair. His eyes do not match: the left is blue (on the viewer's right when he faces us) and the right is amber (on the viewer's left). He says the blue one comes from staring at the lamp too long. He carries a white ash punting pole twice a man's height, with a fist-sized brass lantern hanging from its tip that burns with a small blue flame. He carries no knife. Slow and half-smiling, with a boatman's patience; he calls everyone 'guest'. No jewellery, no glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a sixty-two-year-old man's weathered face, deep laugh lines at the eye corners, creases across the forehead, short grey stubble; mismatched eyes, the left blue and the right amber; a slow, crooked half-smile.
build: 160 cm, short and stocky, thick shoulders, bow legs.
palette: lantern blue, worn ash white, iron grey, brass, faded olive oilcloth
casual: His ferryman's clothes: a patched, faded olive oilcloth long coat over a coarse linen shirt, a rope belt, wide canvas trousers wrapped at the shins, and worn boots. Both hands rest on the tall white ash punting pole planted beside him, and the small brass lantern at its tip burns blue above his head. He carries no blade anywhere. A relaxed, crooked smile.
private: In his shanty: the oilcloth coat is off. He wears a faded coarse linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, a knitted wool vest and the canvas trousers. He holds a chipped clay cup in one hand and rests the other on his hip, with an easy smile.
battle: Leading the dead, in his ferryman's coat and no armour at all: the patched olive oilcloth long coat buttoned up, the hood thrown back, its hem stitched long ago with a faded ward thread that glows faint blue in the dark; the rope belt; wide canvas trousers wrapped at the shins. He holds the white ash pole slantwise in both hands like a staff. The brass lantern at its tip blazes blue, with a half-burned stub of grave candle set inside it, and faint blue light washes up over his face. A grim, quiet look. He carries no blade.
formal: Before the contract court: the dark grey long coat issued to the accused, buttoned to the very top button, with plain grey trousers and clean boots. He has no pole and no lantern. He stands with his hands folded and a dry, tired half-smile.
art: A tilted close portrait, his face lit from below by the small blue lantern held near his cheek. His mismatched blue and amber eyes look at the viewer with a slow, knowing smile. Cool blue light falls on one side and night violet on the other. Foreground blur: drifting blue sparks, faint translucent shapes like broken armour, and the white ash pole crossing the frame.
battle_old: Leading the dead: the oilcloth coat buttoned up, the hood thrown back. He holds the white ash pole slantwise in both hands like a staff. The lantern at its tip blazes blue, with a half-burned stub of grave candle set inside it, and faint blue light washes up over his face. A grim, quiet look. He carries no blade.
gear: 灵格（估）｜贫｜不靠装备｜1档｜旱渡人的头，引得动亡者，所以估他是灵格。他说在这片坡上带刀的人活不长，不穿甲也不带刃，只有油布外套下摆一道旧护符线。

name: 高登茨·丁克尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4448
who: Gaudenz Dinkel, a human and head of the Dinkel house, which holds the grain stores of the southern wall towns, sixty-one in the year 879: not tall, about 168 cm, broad-shouldered, with a fair, well-kept complexion and soft hands that have never had a single callus. Silver-white short hair combed perfectly flat and very pale blue eyes. On his right thumb he wears a copper ring engraved with a sheaf of spelt, the house's granary seal (on the viewer's left when he faces us). Soft-spoken and courteous, he always thanks before he refuses. No glasses and no other jewellery.
face: FACE, as in the references: a sixty-one-year-old man's smooth, well-fed face, fine lines at the eye corners and a soft double chin, neatly shaven; very pale blue eyes above a polite, practised smile that does not reach them; silver-white hair combed flat.
build: 168 cm, stocky and broad-shouldered, with a soft, well-fed middle.
palette: wheat gold, slate blue, cream, copper, dark umber
casual: His upper-city day clothes: a long slate-blue wool coat that closes down the front with buttons, a cream waistcoat embroidered with small wheat ears, a white linen cravat, dark trousers and polished shoes. A short engraved spell-gun hangs at his hip in a fine holster: a wand-like rune piece worn for status, not a firearm. He stands with both hands folded on his stomach so the copper thumb ring shows, with a gracious smile.
private: At home in the upper city: a loose dark umber wool house coat over a cream shirt, and soft slippers. He holds a small loaf of fine white bread and breaks it with a contented look.
battle: Inspecting the mills along the wall road, in good upper-city riding clothes and nothing martial: a dark umber riding coat buttoned up, its lining woven with a thin ward thread that shows faint blue-white at the cuffs, a cream scarf, a low-brimmed hat and polished riding boots; his hands bare so the copper thumb ring shows. He leans on a slim walking cane and looks out with a mild, calculating expression. No armour and no weapon in hand; he does not go up on the wall.
battle_pose: 3) the travelling outfit: standing at ease with a slim walking cane, one hand resting on its head so the copper thumb ring shows, a mild, calculating look; he never fights and holds no weapon.
formal: In the council hall: a long deep-blue coat that closes down the front with buttons, embroidered at the collar and cuffs with a thin band of gold wheat ears, a cream waistcoat, a white cravat, the engraved spell-gun at the hip and polished shoes. He stands with a slight, courteous bow of the head.
art: A tilted close portrait, his face large and to one side. His pale blue eyes sit above a courteous smile, and his right hand is raised near his chin to show the copper wheat-sheaf ring. Warm gold light falls from one side into cool blue shadow. Foreground blur: drifting golden grain and the corner of a sealed paper.
battle_old: Inspecting the mills along the wall road: a dark umber riding coat buttoned up, a cream scarf, a low-brimmed hat and riding boots, his hands bare so the ring shows. He leans on a slim walking cane and looks out with a mild, calculating expression.
gear: 启源（估）｜世家｜不打仗｜1档｜管粮仓的家主，不上墙，从不出手，资料又写他不戴别的首饰。所以只在骑装衬里织一道护身线，不配铳也不配甲。

name: 内斯托尔·奥兰
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4472
who: Nestor Oran, a human and head of the Oran house, the military family of the new dynasty, thirty-eight in the year 868 and a lancer of the highest rank: tall, about 186 cm, broad, with a very straight back. He has the Oran platinum-blond hair, cut short and swept back, and clear green eyes. An old lance scar runs along his left cheek, earned on a night patrol beyond the wall at twenty (on the viewer's right when he faces us). A white-and-gold tassel hangs from his sword. His voice is slow and low, and he always begins with the wall. No jewellery, no glasses.
build: 186 cm, tall and broad-shouldered, with a cavalryman's straight back and strong arms.
palette: white, gold, deep navy, steel, platinum
casual: His house uniform: a long white wool coat cut like a military greatcoat that closes down the front with plain gold buttons, gold piping at the collar and cuffs, a deep navy waistcoat, white trousers and tall black riding boots. A longsword hangs at his left hip (on the viewer's right when he faces us), with a white-and-gold tassel hanging from the hilt. He stands at ease, one gloved hand on the pommel, with a level, measuring look.
private: At home after dinner: a white linen shirt open at the collar, a navy waistcoat, dark trousers and house boots. He holds a white-and-gold tassel in his hands, knotting it for a young knight, with a faint, warm smile.
battle: Leading his lancers, in the Oran house's designed war harness: tailored half-plate enamelled white over fine glowing mail, the plates edged in gold and engraved with rune lines that shine a clean blue-white, a small war crystal lit at the gorget; matching pauldrons, steel vambraces and greaves; a white surcoat with gold edging and a short white cloak. He holds a long cavalry lance upright in his right hand, its pennon white and gold, a thin blue-white light running along the rune-etched head, with the sword and its white-and-gold tassel at his hip. A stern, calm face.
formal: Before the council: a deep navy dress coat with a high collar that closes down the front with buttons, white-and-gold braid on both shoulders, white gloves, white trousers and polished boots, with the tasselled sword at his hip. He stands at attention, chin up.
art: A tilted close portrait, his face large and off-centre. His green eyes are steady on the viewer and the cheek scar catches the light. Cold white dawn light falls from one side with a gold glint on the other. Foreground blur: a swinging white-and-gold tassel and the dark mouth of an old cannon on a wall.
battle_old: Leading his lancers: polished half-plate over a white surcoat with gold edging, steel vambraces and greaves, and a short white cloak. He holds a long cavalry lance upright in his right hand, its pennon white and gold, with the sword at his hip. A stern, calm face.
gear: 英雄（估）｜世家｜照常｜4档｜新朝军门奥兰家的家主，资料写他是最高一级的枪骑，所以估他是英雄。给他一身量身打的白金两色附魔甲和骑枪，东边式样。

name: 贡特尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4492
who: Gunther, a troll of the thunder-prison lands, born at the bottom of a mine pit and about one hundred and eighty-four years old in the year 890, visibly old: very tall, about 205 cm, huge and broad, his back bent from years at the pit's winch. Rough grey-green skin, small pointed ears and a big jaw with short lower tusks. Shaggy grey-white hair tied back with a cord and deep moss-green eyes. Two of his upper front teeth are missing, and the gap shows whenever he laughs, which is often. Huge scarred, calloused hands with mountain-copper dust in the creases. He tells every story starting from the pit. No jewellery.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old troll's broad, heavy face, deep wrinkles and sagging cheeks, bushy grey eyebrows, small moss-green eyes, a big jaw with two short lower tusks; a wide open laugh showing a gap where two upper front teeth are missing.
build: 205 cm, huge and burly, broad and thick-limbed, with a bent back and rounded shoulders.
palette: moss green, mountain copper, coarse undyed linen, slate grey, rust
casual: His contract labourer's clothes: a coarse undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, the grey issue work coat handed out to workers in winter worn open over it, patched heavy canvas trousers and worn boots. A wooden tag branded with his contract number hangs from his belt. A heavy mining pick rests on one shoulder. A big gap-toothed grin.
private: Riding home: the grey issue coat buttoned up, a knitted wool cap and the contract tag at his belt. A small cloth-tied bundle hangs from one hand, and he gazes far off with a soft, quiet smile.
battle: At the mine face, in his work gear with two salvaged pieces: a sleeveless leather work vest over the linen shirt, a thick leather apron with an old grey enchanted plate from the wall armouries strapped over the chest against falling rock, a faint blue-white rune line along its edge; a crystal mining lamp on a strap at his chest, a pale magic crystal lit inside its brass cage; heavy gloves; the branded wooden contract tag at his belt. He holds the mining pick in both hands, braced to swing at rock.
battle_pose: 3) the work outfit: braced and strong, the feet wide, the mining pick gripped in both hands as if about to swing at rock; he never fights and the pick is a tool, not a weapon.
formal: His best for signing the contract: a clean grey wool coat buttoned to the top button, a clean linen shirt and the contract tag at his belt. He holds a dark wool cap in both hands and stands as straight as he can, with an awkward, proud smile.
art: A tilted close portrait, his old face large and to one side. He laughs at the viewer, showing the gap of the two missing teeth, the moss-green eyes creased. Cold pale-blue lamplight falls from one side and warm copper orange from below. Foreground blur: the rim of a turning winch and drifting copper dust.
battle_old: At the mine face: a sleeveless leather work vest over the linen shirt, a thick leather apron, a lamp on a strap at his chest and heavy gloves. He holds the mining pick in both hands, braced to swing at rock.
gear: 共鸣（估）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照坑底推绞盘、挖了一百多年山铜的契约民估作共鸣。他从不打仗，镐是干活的家什，所以只在工装外头加两件捡来的东西，一件挡落石的旧附魔甲片，一盏晶矿灯，都是干活用的。

name: 沙普尔·黑燧
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4509
who: Shapur Blackflint, an old flame-horn demon of the Blackflint clan, a hundred and seventy in the year 890 who still looks thirty-seven or thirty-eight: tall, about 184 cm, lean and long. Two horns sweep up from behind his brow and bend forward into hooks, their tips black like burnt flint. An old blood-oath brand rings the root of his right horn (on the viewer's left when he faces us). Long glossy black hair with a blue sheen, tied back, and molten orange eyes. His palms are always hot. A fire-blackened copper bowl, taken from the empty high seat in his mountains, hangs at his waist. Slow and low-voiced, he speaks as if reciting an old rule. No jewellery, no glasses.
build: 184 cm, tall, lean, long-limbed and sinewy.
palette: flint black, ember orange, burnt copper, dark rust red, ash
casual: His mountain clothes: a long dark rust-red wool robe that closes down the front with buttons, with fitted sleeves, a sheepskin mantle over the shoulders, a wide hide belt with the fire-blackened copper bowl hanging from it, wool trousers, and hide boots wrapped with thongs. He stands very still with his hands loose at his sides and a calm, grave face.
private: In the mountain hall: a plain undyed wool tunic and trousers, a sheepskin over his shoulders and hide boots. He holds the blackened copper bowl in both hands before his chest and looks into it.
battle: Stopping the cart, in the old Blackflint mountain war gear, plain and worn: a dark rust-red cloak over a soot-stained jerkin of hardened hide set with small black iron plates, ember-red runes smouldering dull in their seams; one black iron pauldron on the left shoulder; hide bracers bound with thongs; the fire-blackened copper bowl hanging at the wide hide belt. The hood is down so the hooked horns show, small flames burning along both horn tips. His right hand is raised open, glowing red-hot at the palm. He carries no weapon. A cold, unmoving stare.
formal: As keeper of the empty seat: a floor-length black robe that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a dark red sash and an old dark bronze chain across the chest. He holds the copper bowl in both hands before him and stands upright, head slightly bowed.
art: A tilted close portrait, his face large and off-centre. His molten orange eyes look at the viewer with grave patience. Cold, dead blue light falls from one side, and a small fire on one horn tip lights the other. Foreground blur: drifting embers and the rim of the blackened copper bowl.
battle_old: Stopping the cart: a dark rust-red cloak over a soot-stained leather jerkin, the hood down so the hooked horns show, small flames burning along both horn tips. His right hand is raised open, glowing red-hot at the palm. He carries no weapon. A cold, unmoving stare.
gear: 灵格（估）｜中｜不靠兵器｜2档｜原页没写位阶，照守空座的一百七十岁老炎角、手掌常年烫人估作灵格。山里氏族家底一般，给一套改合身的旧氏族皮甲。他靠手上的火，不带兵器，样子朴素。腰上的铜碗跟故事有关，照留。

name: 雅思敏
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4573
who: Yasmin, Munir's granddaughter, a fire-horned demon girl of eight from Bridgewest village, a small child about 122 cm, wholly covered by her clothes. Two tiny dark red horn nubs just showing above her brow, dark copper-red hair in two short braids tied with straw cord, big ember-orange eyes. Both her wrists are clean and white, with no scars at all. No jewellery. A shy but steady little air; she keeps close to her grandfather.
palette: dark copper red, ember orange, undyed linen, wheat gold, a little sky blue
casual: A long-sleeved undyed linen smock dress to the ankles, a small faded sky-blue apron, brown wool stockings and little leather shoes, a tiny wooden contract tag on a cord at her waist. She holds a bunch of wheat ears in both hands, a shy closed-mouth look.
private: At home: a long-sleeved brown wool dress to the ankles, a knitted shawl over her shoulders, thick stockings, the braids a little loose. She hugs a small straw doll.
battle: The night she was taken and given back: an oversized grey wool winter coat over the linen smock, the sleeves rolled three times, thick stockings and boots, a knitted cap pulled down to just above the horn nubs; both hands clutching the coat front.
battle_pose: 3) the winter-night outfit: standing small and still, the feet together, both hands clutching the coat front, the eyes wide open and the mouth closed; she does not fight and holds nothing.
formal: For the spring name-reading at the gate: a clean long-sleeved deep red wool dress to the ankles with a high white linen collar, the braids freshly tied with red yarn; she stands straight with the hands folded in front.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the ember-orange eyes wide open and looking straight at the viewer, the mouth closed, a serious, steady look. Cool pale blue dawn light from one side, a warm rim on the copper-red braids. Foreground blur: wheat ears and falling snowflakes.
battle_old: The night she was taken and given back: an oversized grey wool winter coat over the linen smock, the sleeves rolled three times, thick stockings and boots, a knitted cap pulled down to just above the horn nubs; both hands clutching the coat front.
gear: 启源（估）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜她是八岁的契约民孩子，那一夜被人带走又换了回来，不出手，手里也不拿东西。这一格是她冬夜那一身，加任何甲件都不对，照原句不改。

name: 马尔奎德·奥兰
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4590
who: Marquard Oran, a human, head of the Oran house, a military family of the new court that rose from a dockhand who climbed the wall for two meals a day; sixty-three in this year. He never goes up on the wall and never carries a blade; his weapons are ledgers, letters and council seats. Tall and thin, about 184 cm, a lean, upright frame. Pale platinum-blond hair combed flat and neat, amber eyes. A plain old iron ring on the little finger of his left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us), his only jewellery. No glasses. A slow, steady, composed air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man of sixty-three: a long lean face, fine crow's feet, two clear lines from the nose to the corners of the mouth, light creases on the forehead, thin straight platinum eyebrows, narrow calm amber eyes with a thin dark upper lash line, a long straight nose, thin closed lips, clean-shaven; a composed, unreadable look.
palette: deep navy, old copper, ivory white, amber, dull iron
casual: The everyday dress of a new-court military house: a long deep navy wool coat closing down the front with plain old-copper buttons, fitted sleeves, a high standing collar, cut to military regulation with no gilding; a white shirt with a plain white cravat, dark trousers, polished black boots. He holds a slim leather-bound ledger closed against his chest with the left hand, the iron ring showing.
private: At home in the evening: a dark navy quilted house coat closing down the front with buttons, belted, over a white shirt open at the collar, soft dark trousers and leather slippers. A pen in his right hand and a folded letter in his left.
battle: At the council when the wall's grain is weighed: a severe black long coat closing down the front with plain old-copper buttons over the navy one, its lining stitched with faint amber ward lines in the new court's austere style, no gilding; a slim rune-engraved spell-gun of fine family make, wand-like, NOT a firearm, fed with a small glowing crystal cartridge, hanging at his right hip by old upper-city custom and never drawn. He holds the ledger open in his left hand and points to a line with his right.
battle_pose: 3) the council outfit: composed and still, standing straight, the ledger open in one hand and the other pointing to a line in it, a slow, steady look; he does not fight and carries no blade.
formal: In the council chamber: a long black wool dress coat with old-copper buttons closing down the front, fitted sleeves, the Oran crest, a plain round shield over two crossed spears, embroidered small at the collar, a deep navy sash, a white cravat, white gloves; standing straight, the hands clasped in front.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and off-centre, the narrow amber eyes looking at the viewer over the rim of the ledger, his left hand with the iron ring near his chin. Warm lamp-amber light from one side, the far side in deep navy shadow. Foreground blur: ledger pages, a red wax seal on a folded letter, a spill of wheat grains.
battle_old: At the council when the wall's grain is weighed: a severe black long coat closing down the front with buttons over the navy one, a rune-engraved spell-gun, slim and wand-like, NOT a firearm, hanging at his right hip by old upper-city custom and never drawn. He holds the ledger open in his left hand and points to a line with his right.
gear: 灵格｜世家｜不上阵｜4档｜灵格（LVL 62），新朝军门家主，家里钱多，料子和铳都照四档给。他不上墙、不带刃，所以不穿甲，只在外套里衬上新朝的琥珀护纹，不镀金。铳是上城的老规矩，做得好，从不拔出来。

name: 佩特鲁斯·施特拉克
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4639
who: Petrus Strack, a human, third son of the Strack house of the principalities, thirty-six in this year, a spirit-ranked knight sent by the council to inspect the thirty-two cannons of Redforge wall-town. Thin and tall, about 183 cm, wiry. Short chestnut-gold hair, sharp light green eyes, a narrow restless face, fair skin. He wears his blue surcoat everywhere. No earrings, no glasses, no rings. A quick, clipped, impatient air; he talks in short sentences and wants to hear the guns go off just once.
palette: cornflower blue, chestnut gold, steel, white, dark brown leather
casual: A long cornflower-blue surcoat to the knees, closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, over a dark brown doublet, a sword belt with a straight arming sword in its scabbard, tall boots. A knotted measuring cord is wound round his left hand; he leans forward on his toes, impatient.
private: In his billet: the blue surcoat worn open over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled, dark breeches and boots. He holds a sheaf of notes covered in distances and frowns at them.
battle: On the wall the night the cannons woke, in the Strack house's war kit for a younger son: a fitted half-plate of old enchanted wall steel worn under the cornflower-blue surcoat, blue-white rune lines glowing along the plate edges and a magic crystal lit at the gorget; matching steel pauldrons and rune-etched vambraces; tall boots. A straight sword drawn in his right hand, NOT a curved sword, its fuller lined with faint blue-white runes; an iron pry bar in his left. A hard, eager look.
formal: Before the council: a pressed cornflower-blue surcoat over a white doublet, the Strack crest, a black anvil, embroidered on the chest, white gloves, a rune-engraved spell-gun, slim and wand-like, NOT a firearm, at his right hip; standing straight, chin up.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and off-centre, the light green eyes narrowed toward the west, the mouth set. A dull dark red glow comes from below as if from a cannon mouth, a cold night blue on the other side. Foreground blur: ember sparks and the iron crank wheel of a cannon.
battle_old: On the wall the night the cannons woke: steel half-plate worn under the cornflower-blue surcoat, a straight sword drawn in his right hand, NOT a curved sword, an iron pry bar in his left; a hard, eager look.
gear: 灵格｜世家｜照常｜3档｜灵格（LVL 52），公国施特拉克家的三儿子，家里给得起成套的附魔半身甲。三子拿不到传家的那一件，所以比四档低一档。他在东边，不用火药。

name: 法鲁克·焦门
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4655
who: Faruk Scorchgate, a fire-horned demon, grand-nephew of the old Scorchgate clan head, nearly ninety but looking about thirty, a peak-ranked fugitive who has hidden in the southern hills with a few dozen followers since his clan was tried twenty years ago. About 185 cm, a hard, lean, powerful build with a thick neck and shoulders. Two thick horns sweeping back from the brow, their tips charred black and bound round with strips of black cloth; no flame has lit on them for twenty years. Shaggy ash-black hair with a dull dark red sheen, dull ember-gold eyes. No jewellery. A grim, fervent, unyielding air.
palette: charred black, dark red, dull ember gold, iron, coarse grey
casual: The old Scorchgate cut: a black leather short jacket closing down the front with iron buckles, the cuffs clamped tight by iron rings, over a dark red linen shirt; dark brown trousers, heavy hill boots wrapped with cord, a coarse dark grey hooded cloak with the hood thrown back. Empty hands, the fists loose; a grim stare.
private: In the hill camp: a rough dark grey wool tunic with long sleeves, a sheepskin over the shoulders; he holds a long strip of black cloth in both hands, about to rewind it round a horn.
battle: Before the door-board at the fissure, in the old Scorchgate door-breaker's harness kept through twenty years in the hills: the black leather jacket buckled to the throat under a heavy black iron breastplate and broad ram-shouldered pauldrons, the ember runes in their seams gone dull dark red; the iron-ringed cuffs over rune-etched black iron vambraces; a coarse dark grey hooded cloak thrown back. The head lowered for his clan's door-breaking charge with the cloth-bound horns thrust forward, both fists clenched; no weapon in his hands.
formal: His clan's old rite dress: a long dark red robe edged in black leather, closing down the front with iron buttons, fitted sleeves, a wide black sash, the horns freshly bound with new black cloth; he stands straight with the arms folded.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and off-centre, the dull ember-gold eyes staring at the viewer with fervour, the mouth set. A dark red glow rises from below as if from a deep crack, cold snow light on the other side. Foreground blur: drifting ash, snowflakes and a frayed end of black cloth.
battle_old: Before the door-board at the fissure: the black leather jacket buckled to the throat, the iron-ringed cuffs, leather bracers, the head lowered for his clan's door-breaking charge with the cloth-bound horns thrust forward, both fists clenched; no weapon in his hands.
gear: 极境｜贫｜不用兵器｜3档｜极境（LVL 90），出身焦门氏家主一脉，在山里逃了二十年，家境如今是贫。到了极境家境差不大，给一套焦门破门撞角的旧战具。他靠角撞，手里不拿兵器；角上二十年没亮过火，甲上的余烬纹也跟着暗下去。

name: 维尔弗里德·莱姆克
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4655
who: Wilfried Lemke, a human, captain of the Sunken Barrel Company, some thirty river salvagers who haul up wrecks from the great river below the capital, a little over fifty. About 175 cm, thick-set and barrel-chested, with strong forearms. A broad face weathered ruddy red by decades of river wind, close-cropped rust-red hair going grey at the sides, a short rough rust-grey beard, warm hazel eyes. Half of his right ear is missing (on the viewer's left when he faces us). No earrings, no glasses. A blunt, practical, gruff air; what can be hauled up is his, the rest belongs to the river.
face: FACE, as in the references: a man in his early fifties: a broad face with wind-reddened cheeks and nose, deep crow's feet from squinting at water, forehead lines, thick rust-red eyebrows, warm hazel eyes with a thin dark upper lash line, a short rough rust-grey beard; the upper half of his right ear is missing, a healed edge (on the viewer's left when he faces us); a gruff, wry look.
palette: river oilcloth olive, rust red, tarred rope brown, brass
casual: A salvager's clothes: a long olive oilcloth coat closing down the front with toggles, the company badge, a small sunken barrel, sewn on the left chest, a thick knitted brown jumper under it, canvas trousers and tall waxed boots; a coil of tarred rope over his left shoulder and an iron grappling hook in his right hand; a blunt, measuring look.
private: Off the river: a heavy brown knitted jumper with long sleeves, canvas trousers and worn boots, a knitted cap pushed back; he holds a mug of hot ale.
battle: At the edge of the fissure, in the Sunken Barrel Company's salvage kit: the olive oilcloth coat belted tight, a grey enchanted breastplate hauled up from a river wreck strapped over it, one faint blue-white rune line along its edge; heavy leather gloves with salvaged brass knuckle plates; a harness of tarred rope around his waist, its brass pulley clamps etched with grip runes glowing faintly; both hands hauling a thick rope that runs off past the frame.
battle_pose: 3) the salvage outfit: braced and leaning back, the feet wide and planted, both gloved hands hauling hard on a thick rope that runs out of the frame, the jaw set; he is no soldier and holds no weapon.
formal: For signing a contract at the wall-town: a clean brown wool coat with brass buttons closing down the front, fitted sleeves, the sunken barrel badge on the left chest, a white shirt and a dark neckerchief, polished boots; standing square with the hands behind his back.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and off-centre, the hazel eyes looking at the viewer with a wry, weathered squint, the mouth closed. Cold blue-grey river light from one side, a warm lantern glow on the other. Foreground blur: a swinging rope, water droplets and a brass winch handle.
battle_old: At the edge of the fissure: the oilcloth coat belted tight, heavy leather gloves, a harness of rope around his waist, both hands hauling a thick rope that runs off past the frame.
gear: 共鸣（估）｜中｜不打仗｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照河上打捞团的团长估作共鸣。他不是兵，不拿兵器。捞沉船的人身上自然有捞上来的东西，所以加一块旧附魔胸甲，绳具上配刻纹的铜件，都是打捞用的。

name: 默娜
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4679
who: Mona, a human mill girl of the lower streets of the capital, twenty-nine in this year, who has sifted flour for fourteen years; an ordinary person with no gift at all. Small, about 154 cm, thin, her shoulders always drawn inward. Long wheat-gold hair in one thick braid, flour dusting the end of the braid and her eyelashes, clear blue eyes that look down first before they look at anyone. White hands with flour that never quite washes out from between the fingers, a pale ring around each wrist pressed by the sieve cords. Fair skin. No jewellery. A shy, quiet, self-effacing air; she always says she does not matter.
build: 154 cm, slight and thin: narrow shoulders held inward, a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips.
palette: faded cornflower blue, wheat gold, flour white, warm bread brown
casual: A faded, washed-pale blue cotton dress with long sleeves rolled to the elbow, a white flour-dusted apron with a front pocket holding a small cloth-wrapped piece of bread kept for her sister, brown wool stockings and worn clogs. She holds a round flour sieve against her hip, eyes lowered, a small shy closed-mouth smile.
private: At home in the evening: a long-sleeved dark blue wool dress, a knitted ivory shawl over her shoulders, the braid undone and the hair loose; she holds a stub of candle in a small tin holder.
battle: On the road to the fire in deep winter: a borrowed hooded grey-blue wool travelling cloak over the blue dress, a thick scarf, the apron still on with the wrapped bread in its pocket, wool mittens, boots wrapped with cloth; a small lantern held up in her right hand.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: standing a little forward, the feet set, a small lantern held up in one hand, the face pale but steady and the mouth closed; she does not fight and holds no weapon.
formal: Her one good dress: a clean deep blue wool dress with long sleeves and a white linen collar, a freshly washed white apron, the braid tied with a blue ribbon; she stands with the hands folded in front, eyes lowered.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and off-centre, the clear blue eyes lifting toward the viewer from under flour-dusted lashes, a small uncertain closed-mouth smile. Warm candle-gold light from one side, deep blue night on the other. Foreground blur: drifting flour dust and the corner of a small wooden name plaque.
battle_old: On the road to the fire in deep winter: a borrowed hooded grey-blue wool travelling cloak over the blue dress, a thick scarf, the apron still on with the wrapped bread in its pocket, wool mittens, boots wrapped with cloth; a small lantern held up in her right hand.
gear: 共鸣｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜共鸣（LVL 23），一辈子没有凝名，下街筛面的姑娘。她做成的三件事没有一件靠本事，手里只提一盏灯，加甲会坏了这个人，照原句不改。

name: 安黛
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md:4679
who: Andai, a human, Mona's elder sister by three years, thirty-two in this year, a barmaid at the ale tent at the head of Stonecutters' Street who raised her sister alone. About 157 cm, slim and quick. The same face as Mona and the same clear blue eyes, but her wheat-gold hair is cut to the shoulders, and when she laughs one small snaggletooth shows. Fair skin. No jewellery. A bold, quick-tongued, warm air; she never lets go of someone she has chosen.
face: FACE, as in the references: the same soft oval face as her sister, clear blue gently slanted eyes with a thin dark upper lash line, straight wheat-gold eyebrows, a small nose, a wide easy grin that shows one small snaggletooth on her upper right side (on the viewer's left when she faces us); otherwise ordinary human teeth, NO fangs.
build: 157 cm, slim and quick: a modest bust, a narrow waist and lightly rounded hips.
palette: wheat gold, clear blue, ale-tent deep red, linen white, warm brown
casual: A barmaid's clothes: a deep red bodice laced down the front over a white linen blouse with the sleeves pushed up, a long brown wool skirt, a short white apron, brown boots. She balances a wooden tray with two tankards on her left hand and laughs with the snaggletooth showing.
private: At home: a long-sleeved soft heather-blue wool dress, a knitted shawl tied at the chest, the hair tucked behind her ears; she holds out a small piece of bread toward the viewer.
battle: Walking off after her man to swear the oath: a hooded deep red wool travelling cloak closing down the front with buttons over the brown dress, a scarf, sturdy boots, a small travel bundle in her left hand.
battle_pose: 3) the road outfit: standing with the chin up and the feet set, a small travel bundle in one hand, a stubborn, cheerful look with the mouth closed; she does not fight and holds no weapon.
formal: Her best dress: a deep red wool dress with long sleeves and a laced front, a white linen collar, a clean white apron, the hair brushed and pinned back on one side; she stands with the hands on her hips, grinning.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and off-centre, the clear blue eyes bright with laughter, the mouth open in a laugh that shows the one snaggletooth. Warm lamp-orange light from one side, a deep red shadow on the other. Foreground blur: tankard foam, a swinging tent lantern and drifting sparks.
battle_old: Walking off after her man to swear the oath: a hooded deep red wool travelling cloak closing down the front with buttons over the brown dress, a scarf, sturdy boots, a small travel bundle in her left hand.
gear: 启源（估）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜原页没写位阶，照酒棚女招待估作启源。这一格是她追着去立誓的赶路那一身，她不打仗，也不拿兵器，照原句不改。

name: 葵丝·刻雪
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md
who: Kuisi Snowcarve, a tiefling stonecarver who became a legend sixty years ago and has looked twenty-seven ever since; eighty-seven in this year. 169 cm, a straight back and long fingers. Peach-pink hair cut to the shoulders, warm gold-brown eyes; two short milky-white horns sweep back flat against the top of her head, the left horn (on the viewer's right when she faces us) marked by one thin scratch from practising with a chisel. Fair skin. She keeps her cuffs rolled up even in winter. No earrings, no glasses, no other jewellery. A quick, frank, warm air; she asks what you want to keep before she carves, and says it hurts when it hurts.
build: 169 cm, straight-backed and long-limbed: firm shoulders, a D-cup, a slim waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: peach pink, grey-blue, milky white, warm gold-brown, stone
casual: A carver's working clothes: an ivory linen shirt with the cuffs rolled to the elbow, a dark brown wool waistcoat, a long grey-blue canvas apron with narrow pockets sewn along the hem holding rolled rubbing papers, a small flower painted in white at the apron's corner, sturdy brown trousers and thick-soled boots. A carving mallet in her right hand and a flat chisel tucked in her belt; a bright, frank smile.
private: At home: a long-sleeved soft peach wool dress to the shins, the sleeves rolled, thick stockings and soft shoes; she holds up a small stone chip carved with a flower, showing it off.
battle: On the colossus, in a carver's kit of the finest make and no ornament at all: the grey-blue apron tied tight, its canvas woven with faint white ward thread, rubbing papers in the hem pockets and the small white flower painted at the corner; the sleeves rolled; close-fitting dark mountain-copper plates at the knees and elbows where leather patches would be, engraved with thin white crack-runes; thick-soled boots. A heavy iron chisel in her left hand and the mallet raised in her right, white light branching from the chisel tip like flower stems; small golden flower patterns glow in her gold-brown eyes.
formal: At the raising of the breastplate tablet: a long deep grey-blue wool dress closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the hem embroidered with small white flowers, a short dark brown wool cape; she stands straight with the hands folded in front, a quiet smile.
art: A tilted close portrait, the face large and off-centre, the gold-brown eyes glinting with tiny golden flower shapes, a frank half-smile. A bright white light flares up from one side as from a struck chisel, cold dawn blue on the other. Foreground blur: drifting stone dust, flakes of rusted armour and a small carved stone flower.
battle_old: On the colossus: the grey-blue apron tied tight, the sleeves rolled, leather patches at the knees and elbows, thick-soled boots, a heavy iron chisel in her left hand and the mallet raised in her right, white light branching from the chisel tip like flower stems; small golden flower patterns glow in her gold-brown eyes.
gear: 传奇｜中｜朴素｜5档｜巨像那一夜凝名成了传奇，档照传奇给，家境不再算。她是碑匠，一身干活的衣裳去剥巨像，画花的围裙是故事里两边弓手都看见的东西，必须留着。所以只用最好的料子，样子照旧朴素，不加一点装饰。

name: 冈娜·炉脉
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_六_麦的年月.md
who: Gunna Forgevein, a dwarf woman of the forge city who became a legend at seventy-four and has looked in her twenties ever since; eighty-seven in this year. Small, 139 cm, broad-shouldered and sturdy, her wrists a size thicker than most. Rose-gold hair in two thick short braids, a hollow copper bead tied at the end of the right braid (on the viewer's left when she faces us), deep teal eyes, freckles across the bridge of the nose, a round face. No earrings, no glasses. A cheerful, stubborn, self-mocking air; she turns her own failures into jokes and gets flustered when praised.

EXPRESSION in this version (Dean of the Obsidian Academy, years 863 to 945, about eight hundred years after she first woke): still composed and cool at first glance, but now alive at the edges: one brow lifted a hair, the corner of the mouth tucked in mild impatience or a faint smug lift, the eyes sharp and attentive instead of blank.
